Privacy Policy

In short: this website does not collect your personal information.

Effective date: 2026-10-31 · Operator: Davy Kim (ipe Studio)

1. Information we collect: none

play.ipe.rest ("the Site") is a portal for games operated by an individual developer, Davy Kim (ipe Studio). The Site has no accounts or sign-in, and it does not collect or send to any server any personal information such as your name, email, contact details, location or device identifiers.

The Site contains no advertising, analytics or tracking tags.

2. The website

The play.ipe.rest website uses no cookies and includes no analytics or advertising tags. Fonts are served from the site itself. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, and GitHub's server-log policies apply. Your browser may keep a language choice on your own device only; it is never sent to us.

3. Third parties and the games

Because we collect no personal information, we have nothing to share with or sell to third parties. The Site links to each game's own official website. Each game has its own privacy policy, and what a game collects is described there, not here.

4. Questions and your rights

To request access, correction, deletion or suspension of processing of your personal information, or to ask any question, write to ipe.haven@gmail.com. Note that because we hold no personal information, there may be nothing to act on.

5. Children

The Site is not directed to children under 14 (or the minimum age in your region), and it collects no personal information from any user.

6. Privacy officer

Name: Davy Kim (ipe Studio) · Contact: ipe.haven@gmail.com

7. Remedies (Korea)

  • Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: 1833-6972 · kopico.go.kr
  • Personal Information Infringement Report Center: 118 · privacy.kisa.or.kr
  • Supreme Prosecutors' Office Cybercrime Division: 1301 · National Police Agency Cyber Bureau: 182

8. Changes

If the Site later adds accounts or online features that change what is collected, we will update this policy first and change the effective date.
